titre: Back-to-school allowance (ARS, allocation de rentrée scolaire)
resume: Financial help from the Caf paid every summer for each child aged 6 to 18 in school, subject to income limits. Automatic before age 16; you must declare it for 16-18-year-olds.
aQuoiCaSert: The back-to-school allowance helps pay for back-to-school costs (school supplies, clothes, equipment) for each child aged 6 to 18 in school, if the household's income does not exceed a ceiling. If you already receive benefits from the Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office) and your declarations are up to date, it is paid with no action needed for children under 16. For a young person aged 16 to 18, you must declare online that they are still in school or an apprentice, otherwise nothing is paid.
quiEstConcerne: Families with a child aged 6 to 18 in school or enrolled with the Cned (the national distance learning center). For the 2026 school year: child born between September 16, 2008 and December 31, 2020 inclusive.
A child under 6 already enrolled in CP (first year of primary school) is also eligible for the ARS.
A child who is home-schooled is not eligible for the ARS. Nor is an apprentice whose wages exceed a ceiling.
aSavoir: Amounts for the 2026 school year, after CRDS (a social contribution deducted at source): €426.87 for ages 6 to 10, €450.41 for ages 11 to 14, €466.02 for ages 15 to 18 (age on December 31, 2025).
Income ceilings for the 2026 school year (2024 net taxable income by category): €28,956 for 1 child, €35,638 for 2, €42,320 for 3, plus €6,682 for each additional child.
If your income is slightly above the ceiling, a reduced (differential) allowance may be paid.
In the general case, payment from August 18, 2026. The official page gives no separate date for Guadeloupe (only La Réunion and Mayotte have their own date, August 4, 2026): check with the Caf.

To receive the ARS for a 16 to 18-year-old, you must have filed your 2025 income tax return and declared your 2024 income to the Caf, then declare from mid-July that they will be in school or an apprenticeship for the 2026 school year.
Separated parents: the ARS is not split, even with shared residence. It is paid in full to the parent designated as the beneficiary (only family allowances can be split).
